plain_definition: A standardised periodic report that HKMA requires Authorized Institutions (banks) to file for prudential-supervision purposes, identified by a form code such as 'MA(BS)3' -- each covering a specific area of a bank's business, such as assets and liabilities or a particular class of exposure. A 'return template' is the blank or proposed version of a return; HKMA periodically consults on new or amended templates, together with their completion instructions and explanatory notes, before finalising a version institutions must use.
formal_definition: A statistical or supervisory return required from Authorized Institutions under the Banking Ordinance (Cap. 155) and related HKMA guidance, identified by a form code (commonly from the 'MA(BS)' series); HKMA consults on and revises these templates, and their accompanying completion instructions, from time to time, including as part of implementing the Cryptoassets Standard.
